script_text: A sudden shift in cosmic energy will shake your fiery Fire sign core this week. Early this week, Saturn squares your ruling planet Mars while sitting in your 10th House of career, creating frustrating delays. Monday is heavily impacted because Saturn limits your professional advancement. However, Venus sextiles Mars in your 5th House, sparking a beautiful romantic connection that eases the tension. The turning point occurs Wednesday when the Moon trines your Mars, flushing out emotional clarity. Late week brings Jupiter into your 11th House of hopes, promising a weekend filled with social expansion. Your Fire burns brighter as financial opportunities manifest on Sunday. Tuesday is your power day because Venus enters your 5th House of love. Monday is your worst day because Saturn squares your Midheaven in the 10th House. Trust your instincts and avoid impulsive reactions at work today. Follow for daily updates.
